title: Night Orchid
summary: Extract Night Orchid to make Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation. A flower can also be offered to Shadowheart.

fields.Extraction: Combine 3 Night Orchids to make Solution of Night Orchid.
fields.Recipe: Combine the solution with any Vitriol to brew Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation. It grants one extra level 3 spell slot until Long Rest and replaces a prior elixir.
fields.Companion interaction: If Shadowheart has told you it is her favourite flower, offer her one for a companion interaction.
fields.Acquisition: Ruined Battlefield, hidden Night Orchid Cave beneath the Cloister of Sombre Embrace, or Popper.
fields.Base value: 17 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
